title: One SBOM component
description: declaration is closed: a component a manifest or lockfile DECLARES, or one INFERRED from vendored file evidence. source.evidence_kind is re-derived from the basename of source.path by sbom_family_contracts.py, and declaration from evidence_kind, so an inferred vendored component cannot be relabelled declared. No description, licence, supplier, author, URL or free-text field exists. P37: declaration build-observed marks an OS-package component the native build consumed (source.evidence_kind build-dependency-evidence; source names the unit's build-dependencies.json in the accepted 02-native-build attempt with its sha256). scope and build_evidence are null except on components derived from build-dependency records. P43: declaration image-observed marks an installed OS package of a resolved Dockerfile base image, read from the accepted 02-iac-config-scan outputs/base-image-inventory.json (source.evidence_kind base-image-inventory-evidence; source names that document with its sha256); its scope is container-base and image_evidence cites each image reference (BI- record, declared repository/tag/digest, the resolved manifest, the Dockerfile line, the layer) with the distribution's EOL status. image_evidence is null on every other component.

source.description: The file in the source snapshot that produced this component, with the sha256 of its bytes.

scope.description: load-time: a built binary names one of the component's files in DT_NEEDED (directly or through a loaded library) or, for a vendored tree, the unit compiled its sources; build-time: only its headers or link-time files were consumed. container-base (P43): installed in a base image a Dockerfile of the target builds FROM; presence in the image, not use.

build_evidence.description: The consumed paths (first 16, sorted; path_count counts them all) and the native-build units that recorded them.
